title: Chronological Bible Reading Plan - Whole-Chapter Edition

chronology.source: Thomas Nelson, The Chronological Study Bible, NKJV (2008)
chronology.method: Chapter order is derived from the median source-page position of each chapter in the supplied NKJV chronological page audit. Chapters absent from page headers are placed between their adjacent chapters. Gospel chapter anchors are monotonically adjusted to preserve chapter context when converting the source's verse-level harmony into whole-chapter readings.

translation_policy.note: A Bible version supplies text or links; it does not alter plan order, day IDs, or progress.

boundary_policy.minimum: Every reading starts at verse 1 and ends at the final verse of a chapter.
boundary_policy.grouping: Daily groups balance reading load while preferring literary-section and book transitions.

source_files: Thomas Nelson - The Chronological Study Bible (2008).pdf
